name: Jaasiel
title: Warrior under King David
summary: Jaasiel is a biblical figure mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Abner and was appointed as leader over the tribe of Benjamin during King David's reign. He may also be identical to Jaasiel from Zobah, listed among David's mighty men.

keyEvents.title: Leader over Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jaasiel, son of Abner, was appointed as leader over the tribe of Benjamin during David's kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Among David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: A Jaasiel from Zobah is mentioned among the mighty men who served King David, possibly the same person.

keyEvents.title: Abner's Son and Legacy
keyEvents.description: As the son of Abner, the former military commander under King Saul, Jaasiel carried with him an important family history linked to the tribe of Benjamin and the Israelite kingdom.

keyEvents.title: David's Administration
keyEvents.description: Jahziel was part of David's administrative system where each tribe had an appointed leader, which helped keep the kingdom united.
